prompt: A tool writes a first draft of an email from a short prompt.
why: The tool writes new text that didn't exist before, starting from a prompt. Creating new content is a generative task.
trap: It doesn't sort the email into a category.

prompt: An app creates a new image from the text 'a cat in a spacesuit'.
why: The app makes a brand-new image from a text description. Producing new content is generative AI.
trap: Recognizing a cat would be classification.

prompt: A chatbot predicts the next word, over and over, to build an answer.
tells: predicts the next word, over and over
why: The chatbot builds its answer by predicting one word at a time and adding it to the text. That's how generative language models write.
trap: Each step picks a word, but the system generates text.

prompt: A model produces new song melodies in a style it learned.
why: The model produces new melodies in a style it learned, rather than labeling existing ones. Creating new content is generative.

prompt: Code suggestions appear as you type, written by a model.
why: The model writes new code as you type instead of choosing from fixed options. That's a generative task.
trap: It's running at inference time, but the kind of model is generative.

prompt: A tool summarizes a long report into a short paragraph in its own words.
why: The summary is new text in the tool's own words, not sentences copied out. Writing new text is generative.
trap: It doesn't copy or label sentences.
